measurementBoundaries: Known-world native invalidity is not a complete census of every global world.
Per-live-world native body/shape/contact/joint counts are observed; post-destroy world counts are unavailable/null.
Lazy debug-shape caches are only one bridge-defined handle subset; no complete all-handle counter is available.
Core/bridge bytes and completed b3DestroyMesh calls are not malloc/free call counts or a proof of zero leaks in every allocator/resource domain.
Diagnostic scratch and facade scratch are outside the core/bridge byte counters; successful disposal/free call completion is recorded separately, not claimed as a full allocator census.
There are no physics steps, contact/event qualification, dynamics performance, application scene-transition qualification or universal leak-free claims in this report.
